headings.scale: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl (max text-5xl for Hero numbers)

numbers.note: Use monospace for all currency and IMEI numbers to align decimal points vertically.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on all cards, no soft shadows. Boxy and crisp.
visual enhancers.corners: rounded-none or max rounded-md (4px/6px). Never fully rounded.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) on sidebar to kill digital flatness.
visual enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: expose the skeleton for data-heavy sections. border-collapse on containers.

component name.cards: Cardless layout preferred, or strict 1px border flat cards.
component name.buttons: Sharp edges, solid colors, high contrast. Use blue-600 for primary.
component name.tables: Shadcn table, border-b border-slate-200 on rows, compact padding.
component name.dialogs: Shadcn dialog. Strict overlay background bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6.
grids.metrics: col-span-1 for summaries, col-span-2 or 3 for charts/lists.
grids.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children.

layouts.overall: Sidebar (Left) + Main Content (Right). Sticky header in main content.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside main content sections.
layouts.alignment: Left-align numbers unless in tables (then right-align currency).

motion.hover: Slight background tint change (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100). No bouncing.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out on buttons and links.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in (opacity + subtle translateY) for dashboard cards.

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-1).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
accessibility.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for header, overlays, dropdowns.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional look.
media.illustrations: Keep minimal. Use abstract geometry for login screens.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this core financial application to preserve performance and clarity.

login_background.description: White and black striped textile - Use for login page background section to provide a subtle, non-distracting geometric feel.

empty_state_finance.description: Calculator, glasses, pens - Good for empty states or placeholder image for 'No data yet' in ledger.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize legibility over aesthetics for numbers (Total Paisa, Balances).
Keep forms strict and aligned. Ensure IMEI inputs use mono fonts.
Group related financial actions together (e.g., all Account Transfers in one module).
Ensure the Indian Rupee symbol (₹) is consistently formatted using Indian comma format (e.g. ₹1,40,000).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align text inputs and forms.
Create depth through 1px crisp borders, not soft diffuse shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard focusing on 'Total Paisa' as the central massive metric.
Account Management UI should feel like a dense ledger: avoid massive empty space in tables.
Use Shadcn UI components but override border radiuses to be sharper (max 4px).
Install the following font packages or import from Google Fonts: 'Chivo', 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Mono'.
Implement Indian Rupee formatting logically in utility functions (Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN')).
Ensure the Account Master allows easy toggling of 'Active' status.
For the login page, use a split layout with the form on one side and the 'login_background' image on the other.
